# CABE Specification

This is the repository hosting the Concise Attribute Based Encapsulation (CABE)
specification and website.

From here, you can:

- [View the website](https://messier-42.github.io/cabe/)
- [View the specifications](https://messier-42.github.io/cabe/specification/)
- [Discuss CABE on GitHub](https://github.com/messier-42/cabe/discussions)
- [Join the discussion group on Discord](https://discord.gg/tWQyJ8ETA)
